mapper.select: SELECT * FROM documents WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND ((#{deleted}::bool AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND purged_at IS NULL) OR (NOT #{deleted}::bool AND deleted_at IS NULL)) AND (#{scope} = 'any' OR (#{scope} = 'none' AND source_id IS NULL) OR source_id::text = #{scope}) AND (#{q}::text IS NULL OR filename ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%') AND (#{graphStatus}::text IS NULL OR graph_status = #{graphStatus}) ORDER BY (CASE WHEN #{deleted}::bool THEN deleted_at ELSE created_at END) DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT count(*) FROM documents WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND ((#{deleted}::bool AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND purged_at IS NULL) OR (NOT #{deleted}::bool AND deleted_at IS NULL)) AND (#{scope} = 'any' OR (#{scope} = 'none' AND source_id IS NULL) OR source_id::text = #{scope}) AND (#{q}::text IS NULL OR filename ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%') AND (#{graphStatus}::text IS NULL OR graph_status = #{graphStatus})

SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'ready') AS ready, count(*) FILTER (WHERE graph_status = 'done') AS done, count(*) FILTER (WHERE graph_status IN ('queued', 'extracting')) AS extracting, count(*) FILTER (WHERE graph_status = 'failed') AS failed FROM documents WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (#{scope} = 'any' OR (#{scope} = 'none' AND source_id IS NULL) OR source_id::text = #{scope})
SELECT count(*) FROM documents WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND purged_at IS NULL
SELECT * FROM documents WHERE id = #{id} FOR NO KEY UPDATE
SELECT version, sha256, size_bytes, ingested_at FROM document_versions WHERE document_id = #{id} AND version = #{version}
SELECT version, sha256, size_bytes, ingested_at FROM document_versions WHERE document_id = #{id} ORDER BY version
SELECT id, seq, text, origin, origin_model, anchor FROM chunks WHERE document_id = #{documentId} AND superseded_at IS NULL ORDER BY seq

SELECT c.id, c.document_id, c.seq, c.text, d.filename FROM chunks c JOIN documents d ON d.id = c.document_id WHERE c.kb_id = #{kbId} AND c.id = ANY(#{ids,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler})
AND c.superseded_at IS NULL AND d.deleted_at IS NULL
AND c.created_at <= coalesce(#{asOf}, now()) AND (c.superseded_at IS NULL OR c.superseded_at > coalesce(#{asOf}, now())) AND d.created_at <= coalesce(#{asOf}, now()) AND (d.deleted_at IS NULL OR d.deleted_at > coalesce(#{asOf}, now()))
SELECT kb_id, document_id, id, text FROM chunks WHERE superseded_at IS NULL ORDER BY document_id, seq
SELECT count(*) FROM chunks WHERE superseded_at IS NULL
SELECT count(*) FROM chunks WHERE superseded_at IS NULL AND kb_id = #{kbId}

SELECT fe.chunk_id, f.id AS fact_id, f.subject_id, s.canonical_name AS subject, -- 开放陈述的短语在 facts 本身，不依赖旧证据的 proposed_predicate。 CASE WHEN f.layer='open' THEN f.phrase ELSE COALESCE(r.label, fact_surface_predicate(f.id)) END AS predicate, r.id IS NULL AS inferred, (f.layer='open' AND nullif(btrim(f.phrase),'') IS NOT NULL) AS is_open_statement, -- 宾语是一样东西就用它的名字，是字面值（名字、金额、百分比）就用那个值。 -- 只取 canonical_name 的话，每一条值宾语的陈述在阅读页右栏都是主语加短语、 -- 后面空着一片——「Hugging Face, Inc. known as」后面什么都没有 f.object_id, COALESCE(o.canonical_name, f.object_value #>> '{value}') AS object, f.valid_from, f.valid_to, f.confidence FROM fact_evidence fe JOIN chunks c ON c.id = fe.chunk_id AND c.document_id = #{documentId} AND c.superseded_at IS NULL JOIN facts f ON f.id = fe.fact_id AND f.invalidated_at IS NULL JOIN entities s ON s.id = f.subject_id LEFT JOIN relation_types r ON r.id = f.predicate_id LEFT JOIN entities o ON o.id = f.object_id ORDER BY c.seq, f.recorded_at
SELECT document_id, reason, detail, count, example FROM extraction_drops WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} ORDER BY count DESC, reason LIMIT 2000

SELECT count(*) FROM jobs j WHERE j.status = 'failed' AND (#{kbId}::uuid IS NULL OR ( (j.payload ?? 'kb_id' AND j.payload->>'kb_id' = #{kbId}::text) OR (j.payload ?? 'document_id' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM documents d WHERE d.id::text = j.payload->>'document_id' AND d.kb_id = #{kbId})) OR (j.payload ?? 'source_id' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sources s WHERE s.id::text = j.payload->>'source_id' AND s.kb_id = #{kbId}))))

SELECT j.id, j.kind, j.status, j.attempts, j.max_attempts, j.last_error, j.run_at, j.updated_at FROM jobs j WHERE j.id = #{id} AND ( (j.payload ?? 'kb_id' AND j.payload->>'kb_id' = #{kbId}::text) OR (j.payload ?? 'document_id' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM documents d WHERE d.id::text = j.payload->>'document_id' AND d.kb_id = #{kbId})) OR (j.payload ?? 'source_id' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sources s WHERE s.id::text = j.payload->>'source_id' AND s.kb_id = #{kbId})))
